description: My wife and some neighbors did a trash pick up on the wooded hillside between Calumet and Hillside Streets. This is a nice green area which allows those on Hillside and Calumet to see some green trees, birds and turkeys. Unfortunately, some renters see this only as a dumping ground - particularly the tenants who live at 198/200 Calumet. It is a party house for the student who party hard and often. All through the cold they had big blue tarps around the back of the house, complete with heat lamps, big sound system, and lights, which you can see in one of the photos. We were all young once and did our share of partying, but not to the detriment of the neighborhood. For the most part they shut it down around 11 PM, but the mess they leave is inexcusable. During the cleanup, my son went up while they were outside and politely asked them to pick up their trash which he pointed out. Their response "sure man, no problem" resulted in nothing but words... There are lots of parties up on Calumet which neighbors call about, but until landlords jump in and take some action, our complaints will continue. The police have come from time to time and have broken up the parties, but they continue.
status_notes: Noted. Violation was issued by code enforcement.
